description: This file defines structures, macros, and function prototypes related to 'pathspec' handling in a version control system, including parsing, copying, and matching path specifications.

classes.name: struct pathspec
classes.description: Represents a set of path specifications with associated attributes and flags.

classes.name: struct pathspec_item
classes.description: Represents an individual path pattern within a pathspec, including match strings, attributes, and flags.

classes.name: struct attr_match
classes.description: Defines attribute matching modes for pathspec items.

classes.name: struct attr_check
classes.description: Placeholder for attribute check structures (not detailed in the file).

methods.name: parse_pathspec
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into a pathspec structure, supporting various magic features.

methods.name: parse_pathspec_file
methods.description: Parses pathspecs from a file input, supporting null-terminated lines.

methods.name: copy_pathspec
methods.description: Copies one pathspec structure to another.

methods.name: clear_pathspec
methods.description: Clears and frees resources associated with a pathspec.

methods.name: pathspec_magic_names
methods.description: Converts pathspec magic flags into a human-readable string.

methods.name: add_pathspec_matches_against_index
methods.description: Adds matches from a pathspec against an index state, considering skip worktree options.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_against_index
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches against an index state.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_skip_worktree
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches that skip worktree entries.

methods.name: match_pathspec_attrs
methods.description: Matches pathspec attributes against index entries.

methods.name: match_pathspec
methods.description: Checks if a given name matches the pathspec.

methods.name: match_leading_pathspec
methods.description: Matches leading pathspecs, setting directory match flags.

methods.name: pathspec_needs_expanded_index
methods.description: Determines if the index needs expansion for a given pathspec.
